How this page works: Onboard customer → activate their SIM under Subscription (you hand in the SIM\'s ICCID; Limes hands back the phone number) → then sell airtime, data & bundles to that number under Catalog & orders or Dynamic services, and track it all under Recent transactions. Airtime & data top-ups go straight to any active number — onboarding is only needed when signing a customer up to a SIM subscription.
Register the customer with Limes so an account exists before you assign them a SIM & number. The system codes are pre-filled with the values the Limes API expects.

When do I need this? Only when signing a customer up to a SIM / contract subscription — onboard them here, then activate their SIM on the Subscription tab. For airtime, data or bundle top-ups you don\'t need this: use Catalog & orders or Dynamic services, which provision straight to a phone number.
